title: The Hero Starts Over at the Academy
altTitles: The Hero Starts Over at the Academy
Former Genius Hero, Starting Over at the Academy
The Former Genius Hero Repeats at the Academy
Moto Tensai Eiyuu, Academy de Yarinaosu
元天才英雄、アカデミーでやり直す
description: Misato Kyoichiro, the leader of the legendary adventurer group Golden Seekers, is betrayed by his comrades and left to die. In his final moments, he activates a forbidden reincarnation spell and awakens twenty years later as Asai Kyosuke, a student at the Adventurer Academy. Reborn with the mysterious Void attribute, which was mocked as powerless in his new life, Kyoichiro knows that it possesses potential beyond even the powerful Time attribute he once wielded. Determined to surpass his former self, eliminate evil, and take revenge on those who betrayed him, he begins his second life at the academy.
author: Nozomu Amaike
